description: Read one of your client aliases by its SHORT LEAF ("cheap"), not the full "client:7/cheap". Returns each slot with the state of the key behind it (provider, key_label, cost_type, key_is_active) — read this before blaming routing, since an alias can exist and still be unservable if its key went inactive. 404 means no such alias FOR YOU; another tenant's alias returns the same 404 by design, so a 404 is never evidence a name is free globally.
name: gate_client_alias_get
